plugin.name: night-light
plugin._long: Makes the display warmer in the evening.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Turns night light on or off.

option.name: temperature
option._long: How warm the display gets at night. Lower is warmer.

option.name: day-temperature
option._long: How warm the display is during the day. The highest value leaves it alone.

option.name: schedule
option._long: Follow sunset and sunrise, or use hours you set.

option.name: from
option._long: When the warm period starts on the manual schedule, in hours after midnight.

option.name: to
option._long: When the warm period ends on the manual schedule, in hours after midnight.

option.name: latitude
option._long: Your latitude, used to find sunset.

option.name: longitude
option._long: Your longitude, used to find sunset.

option.name: transition-duration
option._long: How long the change between day and night takes, in seconds.
